summary: Quality gate agents produce one concrete class of structured evidence consumed by the broader trust surface.

items.text: Send named gate verdicts and evidence pointers into Trust Layer; gates decide at fixed stages, while the layer unifies evidence and review across the delivery system.
Consume the deterministic red/green bundle from Reproduce–Patch–Prove before issuing a model-based semantic verdict on a bug fix.
See Agent Fencing for the related use case or counterpoint: The platform owns the durable history; agents receive bounded authority and oversight proportional to trust and risk.
See Fire, Track, Review for the related use case or counterpoint: Review the artifact, not the agent. Dispatch the task, track the output, inspect the result.

See Skip the Pull Request for the related use case or counterpoint: In agent-first delivery, gates in front of the integration merge replace the human pull-request review — the operator reads verdicts, not diffs.

See Switching Abstraction Layers for the related use case or counterpoint: Move from code and prompts to tasks, pipelines, reviews and capacity only when evidence makes the lower layer trustworthy enough to manage by signals.
